description: Defines the KeyToMultiValue class, representing a key with multiple associated values, used within the mockserver project for handling key-value pairs with multiple values.

classes.name: KeyToMultiValue
classes.description: Represents a key with multiple associated values, supporting operations like adding, replacing, and comparing values.

methods.name: KeyToMultiValue
methods.description: Constructors for initializing KeyToMultiValue with various input types.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the key name as a NottableString.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the list of associated values.

methods.name: replaceValues
methods.description: Replaces current values with a new list.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a single value to the list.

methods.name: addValues
methods.description: Adds multiple values to the list.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on name and values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on name and values.
